io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide

Class AddonVisibility

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.AddonVisibility

  • public final class AddonVisibility
extends java.lang.Object
    Per-player set of addon ids (category NamespacedKey namespaces) hidden from that player's guide. Persisted via PdcCompat as a single comma-separated string, so it works on every Minecraft version (PDC on 1.14+, legacy YAML fallback on 1.8-1.13). Default: empty (everything visible).

      • runWithoutFiltering

        public static void runWithoutFiltering(@Nonnull
                                       java.lang.Runnable action)
        Runs action with visibility filtering disabled on this thread, then restores it. Used by the guide to re-render "show everything" when the player's visibility set would otherwise blank the menu.

      • clear

        public static void clear(@Nonnull
                         org.bukkit.entity.Player p)
        Clears a player's hidden-addon set (everything becomes visible again). Called to repair a set that hides all content, which the visibility menu never produces (it keeps at least one shown).

        Bulk variant of setHidden(Player, String, boolean) - one PDC write for any number of addons, backing the addon-visibility menu's "show all" / "hide all" buttons.

      • solo

        public static void solo(@Nonnull
                        org.bukkit.entity.Player p,
                        @Nonnull
                        java.util.Collection<java.lang.String> allAddonIds,
                        @Nonnull
                        java.lang.String addonId)
        Hides every addon in allAddonIds except addonId in a single write - the "only this addon" solo action. Replaces the hidden set entirely rather than merging with the previous one, so a player can never end up with more than the requested addon shown.
